steps: 1. Independent Variable (x): The input / cause that is chosen or changes freely
2. Dependent Variable (y): The output / effect that depends on the independent variable

revealWordProblem.title: Apply: Selling Pizzas
revealWordProblem.text:
At a local pizza shop, a customer can order a large pizza with up to three different toppings for $12.49. The shop is open daily from 11 a.m. to 9 p.m. and has a total of 6 employees. The shop spends $1.15 on cheese and $1.95 on sauce for each pizza.
Question: How would you describe the relationship between the number of large pizzas sold and each of the following: the hours the shop is open, the number of employees who work in the shop, the cost of cheese each week, and the cost of sauce each week?
revealWordProblem.imageAlt: A pizzeria sign showing hours of 11 a.m. to 9 p.m. and a large pizza with up to 3 toppings for $12.49.
revealWordProblem.sampleAnswer: Sort each pair by whether one quantity depends on the other. The hours the shop is open do not change when more pizzas sell — the shop is open 11 to 9 either way — so the hours are independent of pizza sales. The number of employees is also independent day to day; 6 people work whether the shop sells 40 pizzas or 90. Cheese cost does depend on pizzas sold: every pizza uses $1.15 of cheese, so weekly cheese cost = 1.15p, where p is the number of pizzas. Sauce works the same way at $1.95 a pizza, so weekly sauce cost = 1.95p. In both of those, p is the independent variable and the cost is the dependent variable, and each cost grows at a steady rate as p grows.

questions.stem: Akela chooses how many hours of sunlight each tray gets. Which is the INDEPENDENT variable?
questions.explanation: Akela chooses the sunlight, so sunlight is subject to choice — that makes it independent.
choiceFeedback: You have the two variables backward. Ask which one someone gets to CHOOSE — that one is independent.
The number of trays is not one of the two quantities being related here.
The number of seeds is not one of the two quantities being related here.
hints: Which quantity did Akela get to decide?
Sunlight was set by where she put the tray.
The one subject to choice is independent.
questions.stemEs: Akela escoge cuántas horas de luz solar recibe cada bandeja. ¿Cuál es la variable INDEPENDIENTE?
questions.explanationEs: Akela escoge la luz solar, así que la luz solar es lo que se escoge — eso la hace independiente.
hintsEs: ¿Cuál cantidad pudo decidir Akela?
La luz solar la determinó dónde puso la bandeja.
La que se escoge es la independiente.

questions.stem: In Akela's experiment, which is the DEPENDENT variable?
questions.explanation: Height responds to how much sunlight the tray received, so height is the dependent variable.
choiceFeedback: You have the two variables backward. Ask which one someone gets to CHOOSE — that one is independent.
The kind of seed was the same for all three trays.
The tray size was the same for all three trays.
hints: Which quantity RESPONDED to the other?
Akela did not choose how tall the plants grew.
The responding quantity is dependent.
questions.stemEs: En el experimento de Akela, ¿cuál es la variable DEPENDIENTE?
questions.explanationEs: La altura responde a cuánta luz solar recibió la bandeja, así que la altura es la variable dependiente.
hintsEs: ¿Cuál cantidad RESPONDIÓ a la otra?
Akela no escogió qué tan alto crecieron las plantas.
La cantidad que responde es la dependiente.

questions.stem: Claire burned 123 Calories on a 30-minute jog. Which quantity is subject to choice?
questions.explanation: Claire decides how long to jog. The Calories follow from that decision.
choiceFeedback: You have the two variables backward. Ask which one someone gets to CHOOSE — that one is independent.
Heart rate is not one of the two quantities in this problem.
The weather is not one of the two quantities in this problem.
hints: What does Claire decide before she starts?
She sets the time on the tracker.
Calories are the result, not the choice.
questions.stemEs: Claire quemó 123 calorías en un trote de 30 minutos. ¿Cuál cantidad es la que se escoge?
questions.explanationEs: Claire decide cuánto tiempo trotar. Las calorías dependen de esa decisión.
hintsEs: ¿Qué decide Claire antes de empezar?
Ella fija el tiempo en el reloj.
Las calorías son el resultado, no la decisión.

reviewHighlights.watchOut: Naming the variables backward — calling the responding quantity 'independent' because it is the one the question asks about.

level1.stem: Leo chooses how many plants to water. He measures the cups of water he uses. Which is the dependent variable: plants or cups?
level1.stemEs: Leo elige cuántas plantas regar. Mide las tazas de agua que usa. ¿Cuál es la variable dependiente: las plantas o las tazas?
hints: Leo chooses the plants. The other quantity responds.
hintsEs: Leo elige las plantas. La otra cantidad responde.
level1.explanation: Find the quantity that is chosen: plants → independent Find the quantity that responds: cups → dependent
level1.explanationEs: Halla la cantidad que se elige: plantas → independiente Halla la cantidad que responde: tazas → dependiente

level1.stem: Gina chooses how many songs to download. Each song costs $1. Is the number of songs independent or dependent?
level1.stemEs: Gina elige cuántas canciones descargar. Cada canción cuesta $1. ¿El número de canciones es independiente o dependiente?
hints: Did Gina choose the number of songs?
hintsEs: ¿Gina eligió el número de canciones?
level1.explanation: Find the quantity that is chosen: songs → independent Find the quantity that responds: cost → dependent
level1.explanationEs: Halla la cantidad que se elige: canciones → independiente Halla la cantidad que responde: costo → dependiente

level1.stem: Ty picks how many laps to walk. He counts his steps. Which is the independent variable: laps or steps?
level1.stemEs: Ty elige cuántas vueltas caminar. Cuenta sus pasos. ¿Cuál es la variable independiente: las vueltas o los pasos?
hints: The independent variable is the one Ty picks.
hintsEs: La variable independiente es la que Ty elige.
level1.explanation: Find the quantity that is chosen: laps → independent Find the quantity that responds: steps → dependent
level1.explanationEs: Halla la cantidad que se elige: vueltas → independiente Halla la cantidad que responde: pasos → dependiente

level1.stem: Lin chooses how many dogs to walk. She earns money for each dog. Which is the dependent variable?
level1.stemEs: Lin elige cuántos perros pasear. Gana dinero por cada perro. ¿Cuál es la variable dependiente?
hints: Ask: which quantity does Lin choose? The other one is dependent.
hintsEs: Pregúntate: ¿qué cantidad elige Lin? La otra es dependiente.
level1.explanation: Find the quantity that is chosen: dogs → independent Find the quantity that responds: money → dependent
level1.explanationEs: Halla la cantidad que se elige: perros → independiente Halla la cantidad que responde: dinero → dependiente
choiceFeedback: Lin chooses the number of dogs. A chosen quantity is independent.
Lin chooses the dogs, so the dogs are independent. Only the money responds.

level1.stem: Ravi chooses how many hours to practice piano each week. His teacher gives his song a score. Is the score independent or dependent?
level1.stemEs: Ravi elige cuántas horas practicar piano cada semana. Su maestra le da un puntaje a su canción. ¿El puntaje es independiente o dependiente?
hints: Did Ravi choose the score, or did the score respond to his practice?
hintsEs: ¿Ravi eligió el puntaje, o el puntaje respondió a su práctica?
level1.explanation: Find the quantity that is chosen: hours of practice Find the quantity that responds: score → dependent
level1.explanationEs: Halla la cantidad que se elige: horas de práctica Halla la cantidad que responde: puntaje → dependiente

level2.stem: Which pair of quantities does NOT change together?
level2.stemEs: ¿Qué par de cantidades NO cambia junto?
hints: For each pair, ask: if one changes, does the other change because of it?
hintsEs: Para cada par, pregúntate: si una cambia, ¿la otra cambia por eso?
level2.explanation: Test each pair: more hours → more money Find the pair with no link: shirt color → no change in height
level2.explanationEs: Prueba cada par: más horas → más dinero Halla el par sin relación: color de camisa → la estatura no cambia
choices: A student's height and the color of her shirt
Gallons of gas and the cost of the gas
choicesEs: La estatura de una estudiante y el color de su camisa
Las horas trabajadas y el dinero ganado
Los galones de gasolina y el costo de la gasolina
choiceFeedback: More hours worked means more money. These change together.
More gallons cost more money. These change together.

level2.stem: A recipe uses 3 eggs for each cake. A baker chooses how many cakes to make. Which is the dependent variable: cakes or eggs?
level2.stemEs: Una receta usa 3 huevos por cada pastel. Una panadera elige cuántos pasteles hacer. ¿Cuál es la variable dependiente: los pasteles o los huevos?
hints: The baker chooses one quantity. Which one changes because of that choice?
hintsEs: La panadera elige una cantidad. ¿Cuál cambia por esa elección?
level2.explanation: Find the quantity that is chosen: cakes → independent Find the quantity that responds: eggs → dependent
level2.explanationEs: Halla la cantidad que se elige: pasteles → independiente Halla la cantidad que responde: huevos → dependiente

level2.stem: Nora chooses how many laps to swim. She records her time. Is the time independent or dependent?
level2.stemEs: Nora elige cuántas vueltas nadar. Anota su tiempo. ¿El tiempo es independiente o dependiente?
hints: Nora chooses one quantity. The other one responds.
hintsEs: Nora elige una cantidad. La otra responde.
level2.explanation: Find the quantity that is chosen: laps Find the quantity that responds: time → dependent
level2.explanationEs: Halla la cantidad que se elige: vueltas Halla la cantidad que responde: tiempo → dependiente

level2.stem: Rosa wants exactly 20 roses. She records how many minutes it takes to pick them. Is the number of roses independent or dependent here?
level2.stemEs: Rosa quiere exactamente 20 rosas. Anota cuántos minutos le toma cortarlas. ¿El número de rosas es independiente o dependiente aquí?
hints: Which did Rosa decide before she started?
hintsEs: ¿Qué decidió Rosa antes de empezar?
level2.explanation: Find the quantity that is chosen: 20 roses → independent Find the quantity that responds: minutes → dependent
level2.explanationEs: Halla la cantidad que se elige: 20 rosas → independiente Halla la cantidad que responde: minutos → dependiente

level2.stem: Water flows into a tank. You choose how many minutes the water runs. Which sentence is correct?
level2.stemEs: El agua entra a un tanque. Tú eliges cuántos minutos corre el agua. ¿Qué oración es correcta?
hints: Which quantity do you choose? Put it after the words "depend on".
hintsEs: ¿Qué cantidad eliges? Ponla después de las palabras "dependen de".
level2.explanation: Find the quantity that is chosen: minutes → independent Find the quantity that responds: gallons → dependent
level2.explanationEs: Halla la cantidad que se elige: minutos → independiente Halla la cantidad que responde: galones → dependiente
choices: The gallons in the tank depend on the minutes.
The minutes depend on the gallons in the tank.
The minutes and the gallons do not change together.
choicesEs: Los galones en el tanque dependen de los minutos.
Los minutos dependen de los galones en el tanque.
Los minutos y los galones no cambian juntos.
choiceFeedback: You choose the minutes, so the minutes are independent. They do not depend on the gallons.
More minutes means more water in the tank. They change together.

level3.stem: Devon adds a different number of scoops of plant food to each tray of seedlings. Two weeks later he counts the new leaves on every tray. Which pair correctly names the variables?
choices: Independent: new leaves counted; Dependent: scoops of plant food
Independent: scoops of plant food; Dependent: new leaves counted
Independent: the number of trays; Dependent: scoops of plant food
Independent: new leaves counted; Dependent: the two weeks of growing time
choiceFeedback: These are reversed. Devon chooses how many scoops a tray gets, and the leaves respond.
The trays are only containers. What Devon varies on purpose is the scoops of plant food.
The two weeks are the same for every tray, so nothing there varies. Devon sets the scoops.
level3.explanation: Devon chooses how many scoops of plant food a tray receives, so the scoops are subject to choice and are the independent variable. The new leaves respond to that choice, so the leaf count is the dependent variable. The sentence check works only one way: the number of new leaves depends on the scoops of plant food.

level3.stem: A movie theater is open 12 hours every day. On Monday it sells 150 tickets. On Tuesday it sells 210 tickets. Do the hours open depend on the tickets sold?
level3.stemEs: Un cine abre 12 horas todos los días. El lunes vende 150 boletos. El martes vende 210 boletos. ¿Las horas que abre dependen de los boletos vendidos?
hints: Compare Monday and Tuesday. Which quantity changed? Which stayed the same?
hintsEs: Compara el lunes y el martes. ¿Qué cantidad cambió? ¿Cuál siguió igual?
level3.explanation: Compare the tickets: 150 → 210 Compare the hours: 12 → 12
level3.explanationEs: Compara los boletos: 150 → 210 Compara las horas: 12 → 12
choices: No. The hours stay 12 when the tickets change.
Yes. Selling more tickets means more hours.
Yes. The hours are the dependent variable.
choicesEs: No. Las horas siguen en 12 cuando cambian los boletos.
Sí. Vender más boletos quiere decir más horas.
Sí. Las horas son la variable dependiente.
choiceFeedback: Tickets went from 150 to 210, but the hours stayed 12.
A dependent variable must change when the other changes. The hours did not change.

level3.stem: Ben wants to run exactly 5 laps. He records how many minutes it takes. Is the number of laps independent or dependent?
level3.stemEs: Ben quiere correr exactamente 5 vueltas. Anota cuántos minutos le toma. ¿El número de vueltas es independiente o dependiente?
hints: What did Ben decide first?
hintsEs: ¿Qué decidió Ben primero?
level3.explanation: Find the quantity that is chosen: laps → independent Find the quantity that responds: minutes → dependent
level3.explanationEs: Halla la cantidad que se elige: vueltas → independiente Halla la cantidad que responde: minutos → dependiente

level3.stem: A phone battery drains while you watch videos. You choose how many minutes to watch. Which sentence is correct?
level3.stemEs: La batería de un teléfono se gasta mientras ves videos. Tú eliges cuántos minutos ver. ¿Qué oración es correcta?
hints: The battery can go down as the minutes go up. They still change together.
hintsEs: La batería puede bajar mientras los minutos suben. Aun así cambian juntos.
level3.explanation: Find the quantity that is chosen: minutes → independent Find the quantity that responds: battery left → dependent
level3.explanationEs: Halla la cantidad que se elige: minutos → independiente Halla la cantidad que responde: batería que queda → dependiente
choices: The battery left depends on the minutes of video.
The minutes of video depend on the battery left.
The battery and the minutes do not change together.
choicesEs: La batería que queda depende de los minutos de video.
Los minutos de video dependen de la batería que queda.
La batería y los minutos no cambian juntos.
choiceFeedback: You choose the minutes. A chosen quantity is independent.
More minutes of video leave less battery. They do change together.

level3.stem: A store owner sets the price of a T-shirt. Then she counts how many T-shirts sell that week. Which is the dependent variable?
level3.stemEs: La dueña de una tienda pone el precio de una camiseta. Luego cuenta cuántas camisetas se venden esa semana. ¿Cuál es la variable dependiente?
hints: A price can be the chosen quantity. What does the owner decide first?
hintsEs: Un precio puede ser la cantidad que se elige. ¿Qué decide primero la dueña?
level3.explanation: Find the quantity that is chosen: price → independent Find the quantity that responds: T-shirts sold → dependent
level3.explanationEs: Halla la cantidad que se elige: precio → independiente Halla la cantidad que responde: camisetas vendidas → dependiente
choices: Neither. They do not change together.
choiceFeedback: The owner chooses the price first, so the price is independent.
A higher price can mean fewer sales. The sales change when the price changes.
